title.suggested: Former Champions Recalled Before Sullivan-Ryan Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a New York Herald piece on former heavyweight champions before the Sullivan-Ryan fight, noting that Tom Allen was living in England with money enough to pass his days in ease.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, February 6, 1882', page 6. Reprinted from the New York Herald of January 30.

facts.fact: The New York Herald reported that Allen was living in England, having made money enough to pass the rest of his days there in ease

notes: Current summary says Allen was living in Boston; the image clearly reads England (OCR error). The Herald's claim that he was retired in comfort is secondhand.
